body:
At Enliven, we are dedicated to help bridge the gap between elders and youth through meaningful exchange. We create concerts and performances small and large to engage seniors of all abilities.

Youth share their musical talents and cultural perspectives to entertain and uplift their audiences. Elders share their love, wisdom and support to the students. This exchange offers an enriching experience for both the elders and the youth, helping create special bonds and memories for all.

heroPhoto.alt: Students and residents gathered together after a performance

estNote: Founded by students in Newton, MA. Now across Greater Boston.

team.name: Aria Malhotra
team.bio: Aria is passionate about women’s empowerment and bringing people together. She has always enjoyed singing and dancing, with music being a big part of her life. She helped create Enliven as a platform to foster meaningful connections across generations through performance and dialogue.

team.name: Reyva Choudhry
team.bio: Reyva is passionate about STEM and making a positive impact in her community. Outside of academics, she is a varsity swimmer for her school, a Bollywood dancer, and a Model UN delegate.

team.name: Saanvi Sharma
team.school: Nobles and Greenough School - Class of 2029
team.bio: Saanvi has been part of the Enliven volunteer team since 6th grade. She enjoys musical theater and singing. She enjoys interacting with people of all backgrounds and giving back to the community in creative ways.

team.name: Teya Mahanama
team.school: Nobles and Greenough School - Class of 2029
team.bio: Teya Mahanama enjoys playing the guitar, ballet and being part of the Crew team at her school.

team.name: Aneesha Khanna
team.bio: Aneesha enjoys reading, baking and listening to music. At school, she does debate, mock trial, and sings with her school chorus. She enjoys public speaking and anything to do with music!

team.name: Reeya Wadhwani - Co Founder & Advisor
team.school: Boston Univ Academy - Class of '26 / University of Toronto - Class of '30
team.bio: Reeya is currently a student of Psychology and Business. Reeya co founded Enliven with the vision of bringing generations together to combat lonliness and foster meaningful connections. She is passionate about dance and loves how music and movement can transcend cultural and generational boundaries, spark conversations, and bring people from diverse backgrounds together.

team.name: Jaya Delong - Co Founder,  Alumni Board
team.school: Newton North High School - Class of '25 / Harvard University - Class of '29
team.bio: Jaya is pursuing a pre-med track at Harvard University and has a special interest in working with older adults. Having grown up playing the cello, she developed a deep love for classical music and its ability to bring people together. She is passionate about Enliven because it allows her to share the joy of music while fostering meaningful connections across generations and backgrounds.

team.name: Ajay Wadhwani - Co Founder, Alumni Board
team.school: Boston Univ Academy - Class of '25 / University of Michigan - Class of '29
team.bio: Ajay is currently studying Computer Science and Mathematics at the University of Michigan. He enjoys playing the piano and spending time with friends and family. He is passionate about the power of music to inspire others, evoke cherished memories and emotions, and spark meaningful conversations and connections across generations.

team.name: Aanika Seth Mohta - Co Founder, Alumni Board
team.school: BB&N School - Class of '25 / University of Chicago - CLASS OF '29
team.bio: Aanika is currently studying Economics at the University of Chicago. Having grown up learning Indian classical dance, she is passionate about sharing her cultural heritage with people of all backgrounds. Her close relationship with her grandparents has given her a deep appreciation for the value of intergenerational connections, inspiring her to foster meaningful relationships and a sense of community across generations.
